svg.aria-label: Real public records from BMRB bmse000297, DOI 10.13018/BMSE000297, Madison Metabolomics Consortium. A and B preserve seven transition positions and heights; C preserves group integrals, with ratio about 1.4978. Conditions: 100 mM in D₂O, 298 K, pH 7.4, DSS reference. Sticks do not specify measured linewidth. Data used under BMRB public-domain policy.
